online.title: Company | ChronoAI
online.text: ChronoAI Accelerate the discovery of truth. We pursue verifiable research and build tools for people to work with AI agents. Our work connects two ambitions: asking better questions and making it practical to act on them. Pause animation Direction is part of the work. Our view is that greater execution capacity makes judgment more important. People choose the questions, define the conditions and decide what is worth pursuing. AI helps carry the work forward; explicit checks help us evaluate the result. QuestionConditionsChecks A connected body of work. trureturingOur research: questions, assumptions, recorded results and limits. NyxIDConnects agents to services. NyxBot is the main agent inside NyxID. OrnnA place to find and share agent skills. CMAChronoAI Managed Agent: persistent agents in the cloud. heca Coming soonOrchestration for agent work. chrono-harnessGovernance for agent workflows — a Rust harness for explicit registrations and scoped checks. Public beta. Each project has its own scope and availability. Source-code availability is recorded per project. Make the claim precise. Research becomes useful when readers can see the question, the assumptions, the result and the limits. Two examples from trureturing: a recorded counterexample shows that a plausible floor formula for OEIS A175406 fails; and an entropy identity relates von Neumann entropy to quantum relative entropy — under explicitly stated conditions, and without claiming unconditional entropy increase. We distinguish Lean-checked results, paper proofs and open questions. The scope of a result belongs beside the result. Lean-checked resultPaper proofOpen question Explore trureturing → Make the work inspectable. 01Start with a question. 02State the assumptions. 03Inspect the evidence. 04Decide what to test next. We look for people who can bring questions and exercise judgment. A useful contribution leaves others something they can examine and build on. Selected public records. October 15, 2026trureturing reading snapshot — a dated view of the public research materials. Read the snapshot ↗ chrono-harnessPublic beta documentation — the documented scope and implementation limits. View the repository ↗ The snapshot date marks when the reading site was built, not a launch or founding date. Bring a question worth pursuing.
